title: RobotTelemetryEvent
description: Canonical schema for outbound telemetry events emitted by EdgeNode over DataFabric and WebSocket

DEFAULT_ROBOT_ID.description: Canonical default robot identifier across all services

WHITE_TOWER.description: White spindle tower base coordinates in meters (REP-103 robot base frame)

GREEN_TOWER.description: Green spindle tower base coordinates in meters (REP-103 robot base frame)

BLUE_TOWER.description: Blue spindle tower base coordinates in meters (REP-103 robot base frame)

SCRAP_BIN.description: Scrap bin coordinates in meters (REP-103 robot base frame)

STACK_STEP_M.description: Vertical stacking step per gear in meters

default_robot_id.description: Canonical default robot identifier across all services

canonical_joints.title: UR5eJoint
canonical_joints.description: Canonical UR5e 6-DoF joint names in kinematic sequence

timestamp_ns.description: Nanoseconds since Unix epoch when telemetry state was sampled

robot_state.title: RobotState
robot_state.description: Current lifecycle state of the robotic manipulator

joint_positions.title: ArmJointPositions
joint_positions.description: UR5e 6-DoF kinematic chain angles in radians in canonical sequence

palm_state.title: PalmState
palm_state.description: End-effector dexterous palm pneumatic actuation and grasp status

is_grasped.description: True if suction or grasp is actively engaged, false otherwise

inference_metrics.title: InferenceMetrics
inference_metrics.description: Edge AI inference latency and object classification metrics

command_id.description: Optional command identifier acknowledged by this telemetry event

workcell_state.title: WorkcellState
workcell_state.description: Authoritative workcell gear snapshot: spawned, in-progress, and processed buckets plus active gear id

spawned.description: Gears resting on the workcell table awaiting pickup

items.title: GearEntry
items.description: Single gear with id and Cartesian coordinates in robot base frame

x.description: Cartesian X in meters (REP-103 robot base frame)

y.description: Cartesian Y in meters (REP-103 robot base frame)

z.description: Cartesian Z in meters (REP-103 robot base frame)

origin_x.description: Pick-place origin X in meters (REP-103 robot base frame); absent on spawned entries

origin_y.description: Pick-place origin Y in meters (REP-103 robot base frame); absent on spawned entries

origin_z.description: Pick-place origin Z in meters (REP-103 robot base frame); absent on spawned entries

color.title: GearColor
color.description: Gear color class routing to its spindle tower

intact.description: False if gear is unsound and must route to scrap bin

in_progress.description: Gears currently grasped or in transit
